title: Kingman crash survivor went to the back of the craft

tellings.quote: she do? His in his own words he said she went back in the craft and stayed in the back.

plain: After a craft is said to have crashed near Kingman, Arizona, one of the beings on board survived, and she went back inside the craft and stayed in the back. Charles Hall, a former Air Force weather observer, tells this as the Kingman sheriff's own words to him, which would mean a local lawman saw a living crash survivor.
